programme_question: What may science safely forget, what must remain revisable, what exactly is being learned or licensed, which states survive representation change, and when can warning be evaluated or transported on those states?
constitutional_commitments: Scientific model worlds are not identical to reality.
Required state is a contract-relative quotient of model worlds.
Evidence constrains identification and reportability but does not create ontic distinctions.
Causal uncertainty remains set-valued until discriminating evidence exists.
Scientific forgetting can be irreversible relative to a later contract when the retained state no longer factors the revised required state.
Causal-learning value and target-licensing value are distinct scientific utilities and neither determines the other in general.

Raw model representation complexity and loss-generating state complexity are distinct; representation changes preserve loss state only when declared loss responses factor through the representation map.

Warning must be evaluated after a loss-generating state/domain is fixed warning-blind, but the loss-state quotient determines warning behaviour only when warning response factors through that quotient.
Within-state warning replication and cross-state warning portability are distinct claims.

structural_obstructions.meaning: Newly legal future interactions/interventions can split an old world merge.
Replacement/turnover can invalidate inherited macro-state meaning and require repair/history augmentation.
Retained mechanisms can disagree on required responses and force state refinement.
Required distinctions can remain unidentified under the available experiment and failure architecture.
A revised required state may fail to factor through a previously stored state representation.
Causal uncertainty reduction does not generally determine target report licensing, or conversely.
A coarse representation fails when one of its fibers contains worlds with different declared loss-response signatures.
A loss-state block can contain multiple warning-response signatures and therefore be insufficient for warning evaluation or portability.

theorem_modules.title: Contract revision, irreversible forgetting, and revision debt
theorem_modules.claim_ceiling: Finite same-carrier representational revision; not physical irreversibility, Shannon rate, empirical sampling cost, or a standalone information-theory novelty claim.

theorem_modules.title: Causal learning and target licensing are orthogonal
theorem_modules.claim_ceiling: Finite noiseless product-world bridge; does not replace RACH or CED and does not claim generic active-learning novelty.

theorem_modules.title: Loss-state representation invariance and nuisance inflation
theorem_modules.claim_ceiling: Finite exact loss-response factorization; no recursive quotient-dynamics, warning-portability, empirical-natural-state, or standalone abstraction-theory novelty claim.

theorem_modules.title: Warning evaluation state and portability
theorem_modules.claim_ceiling: Finite exact warning/loss factorization and portability; no universal threshold, empirical state-minimality, or generic factorization novelty claim.

forbidden_collapses.unless: explicit empirical/model projection with stated adequacy and claim ceiling
snapshot sufficiency factorization is proved for the declared contract
the complete simulator state is independently shown to equal the minimal loss-response quotient for the declared contract
the evidence partition exactly identifies the required-state partition for the declared carrier
response-relevant equivalence under the declared contract is proved
the report is explicitly the fully identified required-state label
never; these are distinct type categories
never; a statistic is a coordinate/observable, not the state quotient itself
the warning-response signature is constant within every loss-state class and therefore factors through the loss quotient
a cross-state correspondence is declared and the warning response commutes with it
the admissible set is a proved singleton under the declared evidence contract
the stored representation is the required state for the current contract; later contracts still require a TU-1 revisability test
an explicit observation/reliability contract shows that the side information is empirically obtainable as that evidence object
an explicit restricted bridge theorem proves equivalence for the declared world/target/failure architecture
the projection fibers are homogeneous for every response responsibility in the declared contract

invariants: RequiredState is defined from scientific interchangeability of worlds, not from measurement convenience.
Evidence refinement can identify pre-required distinctions but cannot manufacture a structural distinction absent from the contract.
A target may be reportable even when RequiredState is unresolved.
Adding future/history/mechanism responsibilities may refine RequiredState without any change in the present Snapshot.
A CompleteSimulatorState may be sufficient without being minimal, natural, or empirically identifiable.
A distinction removed by a stored state label cannot be recovered from that label alone when a revised contract later requires the distinction.
Worst-case local revision debt can be arbitrarily larger than global average partition-refinement debt.
Causal learning can be maximal while target licensing is absent, and target licensing can be complete while causal learning is zero.
Raw representation detail can increase arbitrarily while loss-state complexity stays fixed when all added coordinates are loss-response nuisance.
A representation projection is invalid for a loss contract as soon as one projection fiber contains different required loss-response signatures.
WarningEvaluationState always refines the corresponding LossGeneratingState and equals it only under warning-response factorization.
Within-state warning replication does not by itself establish cross-state portability or a universal threshold.
open_obligations: Stochastic/continuous/approximate extension of finite exact state construction.
Carrier-changing contract revision and lift-invariance of revision debt.
Necessary and sufficient coincidence conditions between RACH causal-learning ranking and CED reliability-qualified target-resolution ranking.
Action-conditioned stochastic loss-state invariance under explicit lumpability/bisimulation conditions.
Stochastic, censoring-aware, evidence-qualified warning portability across calibrated state spaces.
Out-of-sample empirical-state discovery as a factorization problem.

empirical_boundary.rule: Species, islands, floral traits, SDM workflows, sensors, and field protocols enter only through explicit typed projections into (Omega,C,O_D,T) with a stated claim ceiling.
